page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs, operating at a ratio of 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network block storage. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Due to its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.2xlarge is structured for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high parallel compute power. It is suitable for small-scale database hosting, caching layers, and lightweight enterprise applications. The lack of bundled local storage and GPU accelerators makes it a cost-efficient option for memory-bound tasks where local disk I/O and graphics processing are unnecessary.
